title: Acceleration of Your Azure Migration
description: Strengthen your security posture, improve productivity, and boost performance by migrating to Microsoft Azure, supported by Victrix’s cloud expertise.

sections.title: Acceleration of Your Azure Migration
sections.lead: Accelerate your transition to the Azure platform with the support of our cloud solutions experts: increased agility and accessibility, enhanced security. Our Microsoft Solutions Partner-certified cloud experts ensure a secure migration process, with a customized strategy.

sections.title: Why Choose Azure Migration for Your Organization?
sections.intro: Microsoft Azure is a cloud computing platform offering comprehensive services for deploying, managing, and optimizing your enterprise applications and IT resources: infrastructure, security, data analysis and backup, custom application development, and much more.

featured.title: An end-to-end cloud solution
featured.text: Recognized worldwide for its effective response to a variety of technological needs, the Azure platform puts flexibility and cost-effectiveness at the top of its list of benefits. The portal leverages the familiarity of Microsoft products, which are widely used in businesses, making it easy for users to learn and adopt; its user-friendly, graphical interface simplifies the management of cloud resources.

aside.title: Microsoft-Recognized Specializations
aside.text: Victrix meets Microsoft's highest standards for cloud security and threat protection: Microsoft Solution Partner for Modern Workplace and for Security.

sections.title: Benefits of the Azure Cloud Environment
paragraphs: With Microsoft Azure, create custom business applications, manage complex workloads, secure your data centers and benefit from the latest artificial intelligence (AI) and IoT applications.
With unrivalled flexibility and scalability, Azure enables organizations to evolve while staying ahead of change, without ever sacrificing security and compliance.
If you’re looking to migrate your Windows server to Microsoft Azure, our team offers personalized support with a roadmap and total transparency on the migration process.

Victrix specializes in managed services and cloud solutions. As an IT managed services provider, we offer our clients the assurance of operational excellence, a robust security posture and compliance.

sections.intro: Victrix specializes in managed services and cloud solutions: operational excellence, a robust security posture, compliance, and performance for your cloud infrastructure. Trust our Microsoft Azure migration experts to help you build a scalable productivity platform that makes it easier to manage your workloads, strengthens your data security, and drives your business forward.

items.title: Strategy
items.text: Accelerating the cloud platform adoption strategy: organizational motivation, expected results, financial and technical considerations.

items.title: Planning
items.text: Introducing the concepts, estimating costs per workload, designing the cloud foundation, prioritizing workloads to migrate, aligning with business priorities, and planning for the new roles required.

items.title: Deployment
items.text: Accelerating the migration of workloads to Azure, implementing minimal governance, and scaling the proof of concept into production.

items.title: Governance
items.text: Governance tools, strengthening best practices through iterations, cost management, basic security, and resource consistency.

items.title: Security
items.text: Continuous improvement of security in Microsoft Azure: mapping of roles and responsibilities, security strategy, information management, risk management, and compliance.
